subject.title: Preserve provider settings during onboarding updates

question: Should OpenClaw land this shared provider-onboarding merge policy, preserving non-auth provider settings while treating omitted auth fields as intentional clears?
rationale: The code is narrow and source-correct, but the changed merge semantics affect provider config, credentials, and upgrade behavior, which requires maintainer ownership rather than an automated cleanup close.

options.title: Land after exact-head checks
options.body: Accept the shared merge policy once the remaining exact-head QA check finishes acceptably, using the added regression tests and proof as the compatibility record.

options.title: Narrow the preserved fields
options.body: Ask for a smaller allowlist such as timeoutSeconds only if maintainers do not want the shared helper to preserve all non-auth provider settings.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Hold or close the PR if maintainers prefer provider-specific onboarding code to own this behavior instead of changing the shared SDK helper.

recommendation.title: Land after exact-head checks
recommendation.body: Accept the shared merge policy once the remaining exact-head QA check finishes acceptably, using the added regression tests and proof as the compatibility record.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned, authored the latest semantic follow-up commits, and has the strongest recent history on the shared onboarding/config path.
